title: Ned and the Hen
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 2 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds h, b, f, ff
note_for_grown_ups: Getting a little stuck in soft mud really can happen to a farmyard bird, and friends really can help tug them free — a true, gentle garden fact.

pages.illustration: A brown hen with her feet sunk into a patch of thick mud in the garden, unable to move.

pages.text: The hen huffs. The hen puffs.
pages.illustration: The hen straining and flapping, huffing with effort, stuck fast in the mud.
Ned the duckling jumping up and running quickly across the garden towards the stuck hen.
Ned the duckling reaching the hen, taking hold near her to help.
Ned the duckling tugging firmly, pulling the hen's foot free of the mud bit by bit.
The hen standing free on firm ground at last, muddy feet now clear of the patch.

pages.text: The hen is not sad. The hen has fun.
pages.illustration: The hen and Ned the duckling both cheerful, walking away from the muddy patch together.
